raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#43463 bounds the decode indexer's work by the context length, but at the batch sizes we serve (112–256 verify rows) it launches 16 CTAs per row, so each CTA walks 1/16 of a long context serially. With MTP, the four verify rows of a request also read the same compressed keys four times. At long contexts the scorer becomes slower than before #43463.

## Modifications

- For target verification with four draft rows (page size 16, head dim 128, BF16 or FP8 index cache, 64–380 rows divisible by 4) on SM107 (Rubin), score the four rows of a request together: 32 CTAs per request group, each reading a key tile once for the four query rows.
- Pass the actual indexer head count separately from the MMA zero padding; keep the per-row skip for rows with ≤512 compressed blocks.
- All other shapes and architectures keep the #43463 path unchanged. The choice depends only on the row count, so it is CUDA-graph safe.
- No new CI test; the bitwise comparisons and graph replay checks below were run as standalone validation.

## Accuracy Tests

Scorer logits are bitwise identical to the existing kernel over a sweep of 1–384 rows × 2K–256K context, and over 256 captured real length/padding mixes in BF16 and FP8. Top-k selection follows from the same logits.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

All numbers: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 on one Rubin (VR200) GPU, TP1, FP8 KV cache, NEXTN MTP (3 steps, 4 draft tokens), CUDA graphs on.

Scorer kernel, CUDA graph replay (µs):

| Index cache | Rows | Context | Main | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| BF16 | 128 | 8K | 11.9 | 4.4 |
| BF16 | 128 | 64K | 140.3 | 42.2 |
| BF16 | 256 | 8K | 18.0 | 7.5 |
| BF16 | 256 | 64K | 206.2 | 80.7 |
| FP8 | 128 | 64K | 74.3 | 33.1 |
| FP8 | 256 | 64K | 174.6 | 76.0 |

Decode step, same node, baseline → this change → baseline (serving config, BF16 indexer):

| Concurrency / context | ms/step | Change |
|---|---|---:|
| 28 / 8K | 12.40 → 12.21 → 12.30 | −1.1% |
| 64 / 8K | 15.89 → 15.59 → 15.93 | −2.0% |
| 28 / 64K | 13.40 → 13.02 → 13.37 | −2.8% |
| 64 / 64K | 18.14 → 17.23 → 18.00 | −4.6% |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Performance-only change, validated with standalone bitwise comparisons.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

Thanks for this PR! While testing a related change, we ran into the same test fakes. On an H100 with the `nightly-dev-20261103` image, three existing tests pass on the merge-base (`8252e3af63`) but fail on `123cfdd0f8`:

- `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/qsa/test_qsa.py::test_qsa_forward_cuda_dispatches_prefill_and_decode_mqa` fails with `TypeError: _DispatchIndexer.select_decode_tokens() got an unexpected keyword argument 'rows_per_request'`.
- `test/registered/xpu/test_qsa_indexer_xpu.py::TestQSAIndexerForwardXpuDispatch::test_forward_xpu_dispatches_prefill_and_decode_mqa` fails with the same `TypeError`. This one runs on CPU, so XPU CI hits it too.
- `test/registered/kernels/ops/attention/qsa/test_qsa_determinism.py::test_qsa_decode_topk_repeatability` fails with `AttributeError: 'types.SimpleNamespace' object has no attribute 'index_n_heads'`. Its `qsa_mqa_decode` mock also needs to accept the new `rows_per_request` / `num_query_heads` keywords.

The test-only patch below makes all three pass on the PR head (3 passed, 1 skipped: the real-XPU class). It doesn't loosen any assertion and adds a check that plain decode passes `rows_per_request == 1`. Feel free to take it as-is or adapt it:

     torch.manual_seed(42)
     logits = torch.randn(16, 2048, device="cuda").round()

@@ -301,6 +301,108 @@ def kernel(

+    @tilelang.jit(
+        pass_configs={
+            tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_ENABLE_FAST_MATH: True,
+            tilelang.PassConfigKey.TL_DISABLE_TMA_LOWER: True,
+        }
+    )
+    def _tilelang_qsa_mqa_decode_grouped_kernel(
+        heads: int,
+        head_dim: int,
+        page_size: int = 64,
+        ctas_per_row: int = 1,
+        min_scored_len: int = 0,
+        threads: int = 128,
+        dtype: str = "bfloat16",
+    ):
+        GROUP = 64
+        group_rows = 4
+        score_heads = 4
+        assert heads == 8
+        assert GROUP % page_size == 0
+        sub_pages = GROUP // page_size
+        batch = T.dynamic("batch")
+        pages = T.dynamic("pages")
+        max_pages = T.dynamic("max_pages")
+        max_model_len = T.dynamic("max_model_len")
+
+        @T.prim_func
+        def kernel(
+            Q: T.Tensor([batch, 1, heads, head_dim], dtype),
+            KCache: T.Tensor([pages, page_size, 1, head_dim], dtype),
+            PageTable: T.Tensor([batch, max_pages], T.int32),
+            ContextLens: T.Tensor([batch], T.int32),
+            Logits: T.Tensor([batch, max_model_len], T.float32),
+            Scale: T.float32,
+        ):
+            with T.Kernel(
+                T.ceildiv(batch, group_rows), ctas_per_row, threads=threads
+            ) as (request, cta):
+                row_base = request * group_rows
+                q_shared = T.alloc_shared([group_rows, score_heads, head_dim], dtype)
+                q_gemm = T.reshape(q_shared, (group_rows * score_heads, head_dim))
+                k_shared = T.alloc_shared([GROUP, head_dim], dtype)
+                scores = T.alloc_fragment([GROUP, group_rows * score_heads], T.float32)
+                scores_3d = T.reshape(scores, (GROUP, group_rows, score_heads))
+                reduced = T.alloc_fragment([GROUP, group_rows], T.float32)
+                context_len = T.alloc_var(T.int32)
+                table_row = T.alloc_var(T.int32)
+                # Graph verify rows share page prefixes and have increasing lengths.
+                table_row = T.min(row_base + group_rows - 1, batch - 1)
+                context_len = ContextLens[table_row]
+                num_groups = T.ceildiv(context_len, GROUP)
+                if context_len > min_scored_len and cta < num_groups:
+                    T.copy(
+                        Q[
+                            row_base : row_base + group_rows,
+                            0,
+                            0:score_heads,
+                            0:head_dim,
+                        ],
+                        q_shared,
+                    )
+                    for step in T.serial(T.ceildiv(num_groups - cta, ctas_per_row)):
+                        group = step * ctas_per_row + cta
+                        for sp in range(sub_pages):
+                            if (group * sub_pages + sp) * page_size < context_len:
+                                T.copy(
+                                    KCache[
+                                        PageTable[table_row, group * sub_pages + sp],
+                                        :,
+                                        0,
+                                        :,
+                                    ],
+                                    k_shared[sp * page_size : (sp + 1) * page_size, :],
+                                )
+                        T.gemm(
+                            k_shared,
+                            q_gemm,
+                            scores,
+                            transpose_B=True,
+                            clear_accum=True,
+                            policy=T.GemmWarpPolicy.FullCol,
+                        )
+                        for token, qi, head in T.Parallel(
+                            GROUP, group_rows, score_heads
+                        ):
+                            scores_3d[token, qi, head] = T.max(
+                                scores_3d[token, qi, head], 0.0
+                            )
+                        T.reduce_sum(scores_3d, reduced, dim=2, clear=True)
+                        for token, qi in T.Parallel(GROUP, group_rows):
+                            position = group * GROUP + token
+                            if row_base + qi < batch:
+                                if (
+                                    ContextLens[row_base + qi] > min_scored_len
+                                    and position < ContextLens[row_base + qi]
+                                ):
+                                    Logits[row_base + qi, position] = (
+                                        reduced[token, qi] / Scale
+                                    )
+
+        return kernel
+
